title: Console UI: unit economics dashboard (charts, filters, drilldowns, shareable links)
creator: Marissa Cole
description:
Build the Console UI for the internal Unit Economics dashboard.

Goal
- Provide a fast, trustworthy, Finance-aligned view of blended cost as $/1M output tokens, with drilldowns by model, region, and customer tier.
- Support sliceable links (shareable URLs) so Finance/Product/Eng can discuss the same view in weekly reviews.

Scope (MVP)
1) Dashboard page + navigation
- Add left-nav entry under Console > Analytics: “Unit economics” (internal-only for now).
- Route: /console/analytics/unit-economics
- Gate behind internal feature flag: unit_econ_dashboard_internal

2) Filters + URL state
- Global filters (top bar):
  - Date range (default: Last 30 days; presets: 7d, 30d, 90d; custom)
  - Region (multi-select; default: All)
  - Customer tier (single-select; default: All; options: self_serve, dedicated, private, enterprise)
  - Model (typeahead; multi-select; default: All)
- Persist all filter state to URL query params for shareable links.
  - Example: /console/analytics/unit-economics?from=2025-01-01&to=2025-01-31®ions=us-east-1,eu-west-1&tier=self_serve&models=llama-3.1-70b,gemma-2-27b
- “Copy link” action in header.

3) Primary charts/tables (per DES-211)
- KPI tiles (top):
  - Blended cost ($/1M output tokens)
  - Output tokens (sum)
  - Total attributed cost ($)
  - Cache hit rate (if available in response; otherwise show “—” w/ tooltip)
- Trend line: blended $/1M output tokens over time (daily points, with 7d moving average toggle)
- Breakdown table:
  - Rows at selected grain: by model OR by region (toggle)
  - Columns: blended $/1M, output tokens, total cost, request count (if present), cache hit rate (if present)
  - Sort: default by output tokens desc; allow sort on blended $/1M
  - Pagination (server-side) for large model lists

4) Drilldown navigation
- Clicking a model (or region) row drills into a “slice view” keeping date/tier filters intact, adding the clicked dimension.
- Provide breadcrumb + “Reset slice” button.

5) Data freshness / quality UX
- Show dataset freshness badge in header (e.g., “Updated 12 min ago”).
- If backend returns stale=true or last_complete_partition older than SLO, display a warning banner:
  - “Data may be incomplete for the last X hours. See data health details.” (link to internal runbook once available).
- Empty states:
  - No data for slice: show “No results for selected filters” + reset filters CTA.
  - Backend error: standard Console error component with request id.

6) Export
- Export current table view to CSV.
- For MVP: client-side export of currently loaded page + “Export full results” (server-side async) is deferred.

Non-goals (MVP)
- Full driver attribution “Explain cost delta” panel (DES-212) unless it’s low-effort to stub entry point.
- Account-level slices.
- Discount/credit impact breakdowns in UI (restricted; will come later behind tighter RBAC if needed).

Implementation notes
- Frontend: Console web app (React/TypeScript), using existing Analytics layout + shared filter components.
- Data fetching: use dashboard query API from ENG-2915.
  - Debounce filter changes (300ms) to avoid request spam.
  - Cache last successful response per URL (in-memory) for fast back/forward navigation.
- Guardrails:
  - If model multi-select exceeds N (propose N=10), show inline warning and block apply.
  - Cap date range to 90d in UI for now; longer ranges require explicit “Advanced” toggle.
- Access control:
  - Page-level gating via feature flag and role check.
  - Ensure tier filter values respected by backend RBAC (ENG-2921/PR-11905); UI should hide or disable tier options if role lacks permission.

Acceptance criteria
- All filters round-trip via URL: opening a shared link loads the same view.
- Default view loads in <2s for last-30d All/All/All on corp network (excluding backend issues).
- Trend chart + table render correctly, including loading skeletons.
- Drilldown behavior matches DES-211.
- Freshness banner shows for stale data and does not block exploration.
- CSV export includes headers, consistent formatting, and a footer row with applied filters + timestamp.

Testing
- Unit tests for URL state parsing/serialization.
- Integration test (Playwright) covering:
  - filter -> URL update -> reload -> same state
  - drilldown link
  - empty state

Open questions
- Confirm canonical tier labels in UI (Finance prefers: Self-serve / Dedicated / Private / Enterprise) while keeping enum values stable.
- Whether to include cache hit rate in KPI tiles if data is partial (some regions missing tags). Recommendation: show tile with tooltip “Available for runtime_config>=v3 only; rollout in progress.”

Refs
- UX spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/unit-economics-dashboard-ux-spec.json (DES-211)
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/internal-unit-economics-dashboard-prd.json
- Data contracts: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/unit-economics-dashboard-data-contracts.json
- Backend API: ENG-2915
- Access control policy: PM-484 / ENG-2921
